context.projection: O reads a realized later engine result, never retained bytes, passive traces, fixture verdicts or role labels
context.intervention: structural removal of exactly one provenance-bound retained coordinate
context.restoration: exact value and provenance restoration reproduces the state and later result

structural_states.retained_zero: one provenance-bound coordinate with numeric value zero
structural_states.cancelling_pair: two nonzero provenance-bound coordinates whose aggregate is zero

cancellation: A +1/-1 pair may yield aggregate current zero while both sources remain operative because either individual removal changes the later outcome
shedding_boundary: Shedding is an independently computed M1 consequence, not an awareness label. Awareness-conditioned shedding requires both a passed retained-coordinate intervention and a provenance-bound computed surplus/route record with exact restoration.
labels: derived from incidence under full node/provenance renaming; labels never enter the update law or create awareness, closure, folding or shedding
proprioception: unique issued action after issuer/channel recurrence; exact certified-return count projection; later matched use
learning: persistent acquired relation with later removal/restoration
carriage: original retained relation and source action registry, inner identities, exact folded certificate, recurrent outer target and repeated higher contacts; new higher matched effect before next offer
